evidence_text: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DSM 2m metadata: raster DSM covering approximately 99% of England at 2 m spatial resolution; DSM includes terrain and surface objects such as buildings and vegetation; EPSG:27700; vertical accuracy +/-0.15 m RMSE; annual update frequency; creation 2023-02-08; revision 2023-12-15; survey period 2000-06-06 through 2022-04-02; Open Government Licence; no public access constraints; official download-by-area, WMS, WCS, WMTS and OGC API access links are exposed. This matches the previously accepted DTM 2m resolution, while spatial binding/raster sampling and height-difference calculation remain local-only.
